QuestInfo.name: Elma's New Look 2
QuestInfo.0: #bElma the Housekeeper#k in #bOrbis Park#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Elma the Housekeeper now has a taste for prettying herself up. She'd like a lovely Defense Ring II for her calloused hands.\n\n#i1112537##t1112537#  #b#c1112537# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: Elma is happy with her ring.

0.0: It's nothing fancy, but even having a belt like this makes me feel so luxurious. Well, we've gone this far, so let's see what other accessories I can try on!

yes.0: My hands are so calloused from housecleaning... Maybe a pretty ring will make them look better? #bDefense Rings II#k are pretty... Can you get one for me? I will pay for it.
yes.1: Only Jewelers can make them. They're hard to get, but that just makes me want it more.

no.0: Ah, are we going too far?

1.0: You brought me a ring? Let me try it on.

yes.0: Hm... Not bad, not bad. Still, my hands are too rough. I should get a manicure...

item.0: Still looking for a #bDefense Ring II#k? Hm... Maybe you should have been a Jeweler.
